description.value: Mucho Burrito is a Canadian fast-casual Mexican chain serving burritos, bowls, quesadillas, and tacos with a 'Modern Mexicana' approach emphasising fresh ingredients. This Tsawwassen location sits at 4949 Canoe Pass Way — close to the Tsawwassen ferry terminal, making it a plausible quick-fuel stop for cyclists arriving or departing on BC Ferries routes. Vegan and vegetarian options are available across the menu.
